reverse_recipe_contract.entries: same stable IDs and VMAs as the reviewed edits
reverse_recipe_contract.expected_hex: exact forward New bytes, serving as reverse preimages
reverse_recipe_contract.words: independently reviewed original machine words and assembly notes
reverse_recipe_contract.output_sha256: known forward source SHA-256; require exact full-image restoration

recommendation.implementation_delta_if_authorized: Permit and validate existing OutputSHA256 for guarded_words in current plan/run guards; patchCopy already checks the final digest. Keep initial scope to one guarded_words table.

existing_contract.plan: source/glyph pins, explicit expected bytes, word alignment, target words, table composition and validateEdits bounds/overlap
existing_contract.verifySource: regular file/type and size; replan; exact edit ID/offset/operation/Old/New comparison; full source hash; source-state inspection
existing_contract.patchCopy: exclusive new output; pre-copy source verification and copy hash; pre-write pending state; sync; readback state; full output digest; optional output SHA enforcement
limitations: OutputSHA256 is rejected for guarded_words by plan and run even though patchCopy can enforce it.
guarded_words checks exact bytes/alignment and nonempty assembly descriptions, not instruction semantics, references, consumers, control flow or ABI.
A word-only reverse cannot undo coupled stream, pointer, allocation, registry or multi-component changes.

example_pin_pair.meaning: Illustrative known source/output pin pair only; not reverse proof or approval.

test_extension.TestPlanAndCopy: Explicit reverse recipe fixture; success byte-equals original source; reject wrong source hash, wrong preimage, unexpected out-of-recipe bytes and wrong output digest; source remains unchanged.
test_extension.TestCLIDryRunAndApply: Dry-run writes nothing; apply writes exclusive new output and reports hashes; refuse existing output and wrong source hash; source unchanged.
test_extension.independent_recipe_data: Encode expected reverse Old/New bytes directly; never derive reverse by inverting arbitrary Edit values.

semantic_guard_requirement: Only claim reverse for word-only edits whose reference/ABI/consumer invariants are independently reviewed and retained in existing applicable checks. Assembly notes alone are not semantic validation.
scope_limit: Does not support general rollback of mixed transactions or close guarded_transactions coverage gap.
work_done: Read-only inspection; no tests run; no Go/test/recipe/registry/ISO/emulator/process writes or actions.
